long_description:
Girlhood ATX’s Sunset Sculpt Series is back with a spooky twist! Yoga sculpt, cocktails, goodies, vendors & new girlfriends under the sunset

About this Event

Girlhood ATX’s Sunset Sculpt Series is back with a spooky twist! Join us for an evening of movement, connection, and a little Halloween fun with the girls. 🖤
We’ll kick off the night with a 30-minute Yoga Sculpt session led by InnerBloom Yoga, followed by a spooky social hour where you can sip on your complimentary margarita or mocktail from Toastique, explore local vendors, take photos, enjoy a few spooky surprises, and meet some new girlfriends!
Come in your favorite workout set or make it spooky with a workout-friendly costume. Costumes are completely optional! 👻
Your ticket includes a 30-minute Yoga Sculpt class, wellness shot, spooky margarita or mocktail, welcome goodies, local vendors, spooky surprises, photo ops, and our Girlhood social hour.

THE SCHEDULE 🕯️6:30–7:00 PM | Check-In + Welcome
Check in, grab your goodies, get settled, and mingle with the girls!
7:00–7:30 PM | Yoga Sculpt
30-minute Yoga Sculpt session led by InnerBloom Yoga.
7:30–8:30 PM | Sculpt After Dark Social Hour
Grab your marg or mocktail, visit our vendors, take photos, socialize, and enjoy the rest of the night with your new girlfriends. 👻🍸

WHAT TO BRING 🧘‍♀️Your yoga matWater bottleGrippy socksYour spooky spirit 👻🖤

Sunday, October 18 | 6:30–8:30 PM
Tickets: $28 + fees
Come alone or bring a friend. There’s always room for you at Girlhood. 💜
